title: The Tuition Teacher Who Refunded EVERYTHING 🤖

lines.speaker: mim
lines.text: STOP. [beat] Miss Preity refunded my ENTIRE month's fee. [beat] In CASH. [beat] With a note.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Refunded?! [beat] Teachers GIVE money now?! [beat] What did the note say?!

lines.speaker: mim
lines.text: 'You deserved better lessons. [beat] I'm not fit to take your money.'

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: A teacher quitting in shame? [beat] No no no. [beat] This is a SETUP. [beat] Nobody returns money!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: She's been pale all month. [beat] Falling asleep in class. [beat] And her teaching got WORSE before it got weird.

lines.speaker: preity
lines.text: Children… [beat] I have to tell you myself. [beat] There's a new coaching center. [beat] They offered me triple salary… [beat] to teach badly on purpose.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: SAY THAT NAME AGAIN. [beat] LOUDER. [beat] For my notes.

lines.speaker: preity
lines.text: I recorded their offer. [beat] Every word. [beat] I taught badly for ONE week — then I couldn't look at your faces anymore. [beat] So I quit. [beat] And refunded.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: A SPY TEACHER! [beat] An UNDERCOVER HERO TEACHER! [beat] I'm calling every parent I know! [beat] TWICE!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That coaching center's license… [beat] was signed by my office. [beat] Was. [beat] Past tense. [beat] As of this morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The center shut down by Friday. [beat] Miss Preity got her students back. [beat] And a raise — [beat] donated by the parents, one coin at a time.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The note was a RESIGNATION letter! [beat] Follow — next story: [beat] a recipe notebook that ruined a wedding!
